title: Employee Gets Busted For Stealing $30,000 From Work
description:
On May 17th, 2024, an officer was dispatched to the probation office to arrest and transport a suspect with a history of embezzling money, forgery and fraud dating back to 2016. The female was hired as a secretary at C.D. General Contractors around May 6, 2021, but she quit less than a month later with no notice or explanation. She reportedly had no direct involvement with the company's finances, however, she did have access to sensitive banking information including account and routing numbers. The female alleged larceny included 18 transactions totaling $2,946, including payments to AT&T, Capitol One, Discover, Venmo, and Amazon. In 2016, the female was accused of embezzling more than twenty nine thousand dollars from a realty company. Then, in 2021 she was hired as manager of Las Cruces' Dove Canyon Mobile Home Park, where she similarly embezzled cash rent payments. The female was transported to the Las Cruces detention centre for further booking processes. The female was charged with larceny and fraud. As of now, she hasn’t paid back any money that she owes. Youtube thinks you’ll love the video on screen, click to watch now.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
